crossRefs.note: But Absalom fled. The young man who kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold, many people were coming…
Now David was sitting between the two gates; and the watchman went up to the roof of the gate to the wall, and lifted…
For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.
The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”
The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”
His watchmen are blind. They are all without knowledge. They are all mute dogs. They can’t bark— dreaming, lying down…
I have set watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem. They will never be silent day nor night. You who call on Yahweh, take no…
“Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and tell them, ‘When I bring the sword on a land, and the people of…
Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,
Therefore they took two chariots with horses; and the king sent them out to the Syrian army, saying, “Go and see.”
Then he sent out a second on horseback, who came to them, and said, “The king says, ‘Is it peace?’ ” Jehu answered…
Samuel did that which Yahweh spoke, and came to Bethlehem. The elders of the city came to meet him trembling, and said…
David left his baggage in the hand of the keeper of the baggage, and ran to the army, and came and greeted his brothers.
He said, “You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign. However…
Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

people.name: Jehu
people.line: Son of Jehoshaphat, king of Israel, destroyed Ahab's dynasty.

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A city in Issachar, associated with Ahab and Jezebel

people.name: Joram
people.line: King of N. Israel, son of Ahab

translations.web: Now the watchman was standing on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, “I see a company.” Joram said, “Take a horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, ‘Is it peace?’ ”
translations.bsb: Now the watchman standing on the tower in Jezreel saw Jehu’s troops approaching, and he called out, “I see a company of troops!” “Choose a rider,” Joram commanded. “Send him out to meet them and ask, ‘Have you come in peace?’”
translations.kjv: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?
